quality.rationale: UI reposition, left-panel Templates/Layers/Assets order, right inspector Adjust/Colors/Motion tabs, preview-header output controls, Output-section image import, hidden YouTube URL UI, asset deletion with related image-layer cleanup, final-layer deletion to zero rows, template confirmation with aspect-ratio application, upper-right Language and Theme controls, System/Light/Dark theme persistence, side-by-side preview-pane Export and Edit state sections with vertical button stacks, reorderable saved palettes and registered single colors, collapsible Layers Quick Add, collapsible layer list, horizontal and vertical even distribution, hidden Generated layout section, preview pan, user-controlled zoom on preset changes, fixed output-frame preview during off-canvas drags, outside-frame deselection, Colors layout cleanup, draggable popup Adjust single-color picker, hidden Colors-side Brand kit registration buttons, expanded shape kinds, rounded polygon corners, Image Lab asset-row entry with no-range default, deletion selection clearing, resizable Default and Browser template lists, popup-style OBS preview, Schedule templates, expanded Motion/easing controls with multiple motion sets and direction disabling, expanded hosted font options, Google Analytics tracking, and vertical text display-bound resizing are implemented and verified with automated tests, production build, and headless Chromium runtime gate. Coverage includes exactly 38 bundled default templates, hidden left Layouts tab, removed guided start, hidden Templates Brand kit setup, CSV/HTML persistence, inspector editing, Colors collapses and reorder persistence, maximum-quality WebP export, mobile no-overflow, user-facing docs, and QCDS evidence. Cross-browser, real-device, and real OBS setup edge cases remain future work.

cost.rationale: Static browser-only GitHub Pages app with no backend, no paid service dependency, browser-local edit state, template, color, saved palette, and custom font storage, and client-side YouTube thumbnail import.

delivery.rationale: TODO and local Issues are closed, implementation and docs are aligned, README, user guide, and screenshot guide are present, QCDS evidence is recorded, tests/build/runtime gate pass, docs packaging remains available through the existing workflow, and the GitHub Pages workflow passed for the pushed codex/thumbnail-generator-static-app branch.

satisfaction.rationale: Requested UI cleanup and follow-up changes passed validation: left tabs are Templates/Layers/Assets, right inspector no longer shows a Layers tab, the Output section contains image import, preview header contains preset/width/height controls, layer-count/canvas-size text is removed from the preview header, YouTube URL UI is hidden, registered/imported asset rows have delete actions that also remove referencing image layers, all layers can be deleted down to zero rows, Layers no longer shows Restore sample, template application confirms before replacing the current state and applies the template aspect ratio, Export and Edit state sit side by side with vertical action stacks, saved palettes and registered single colors reorder by drag-and-drop with localStorage persistence, Language is in the upper-right toolbar area, Theme sits beside it with System/Light/Dark modes, left Layouts is hidden, guided start is removed, Templates Brand kit setup is hidden, Quick Add is moved to Layers with collapse controls, the layer list collapses, even distribution is added, preview zoom stays user-controlled with pan available, off-canvas dragging keeps zoom scale and output-frame size stable, clicking outside the output frame clears selection, Colors places the pattern dropdown beside the wheel and removes Brand kit registration buttons, Adjust opens a draggable popup alpha-capable single-color picker from Fill/Stroke displays, redundant opacity controls are removed, Shape supports Diamond/Pentagon/Hexagon/Star with rounded polygon corners, Image Lab opens only from imported asset rows and no longer duplicates source/import controls, chroma-key settings are separated from processed-layer creation, Default and Browser template lists are resizable, and OBS preview opens a popup-style canvas-only document. CSV/HTML parser and persistence coverage remains in automated tests, WebP export works, and QCDS evidence is updated. Remaining satisfaction risk is broader real-user font files, real-device checks, non-Chromium browser coverage, and real OBS capture behavior.

openItemsBeforeReview: Default templates 38 practical layouts with Schedule, Motion, weekly Sunday-start templates, expanded easing, and Motion/OBS preview
